en_title: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet in 'Last Stages of Production,' Neil Druckmann calls it a Mash-up of Jak and Daxter, Uncharted and The Last of Us
cn_title: 《星际：异端先知》处于「制作的最后阶段」，Neil Druckmann称其融合了《Jak and Daxter》《神秘海域》和《最后生还者》
opus_summary: 顽皮狗负责人Neil Druckmann表示，《星际：异端先知》已进入「制作最后阶段」，目前可以游玩，开发重点是改进和打磨。他称游戏融合了《Jak and Daxter》、《神秘海域》和《最后生还者》的元素，并希望在保持电影式叙事的同时深化游戏系统。

paragraphs.en: Naughty Dog boss Neil Druckmann has given a seemingly promising update on the studio's long-awaited Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet , and offered a fresh tease of what to expect.
paragraphs.cn: 顽皮狗负责人Neil Druckmann介绍了工作室备受期待的《星际：异端先知》的最新进展，消息似乎令人振奋，他还透露了一些关于游戏内容的新线索。

paragraphs.en: PlayStation's upcoming, under-wraps space blockbuster remains largely a mystery, despite being revealed almost two years ago at The Game Awards in December 2024. We know only fragments of its story, and still have no idea when it will launch.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管PlayStation这款即将推出、尚未揭开神秘面纱的太空大作近两年前就已在2024年12月的The Game Awards上公布，但它在很大程度上仍是个谜。我们只知道其故事的零星片段，至今也不知道它何时会发售。

paragraphs.en: Speaking at the Comic Creators Block Party 2026 , Druckmann said Intergalactic was now moving into its "last stages of production" and that the game was playable, with work now focusing on "refining and polishing." More intriguingly still, Druckmann described Intergalactic as an amalgamation of three other famous Naughty Dog franchises, with elements included from each.
paragraphs.cn: Druckmann在Comic Creators Block Party 2026上表示，《星际：异端先知》目前正进入「制作的最后阶段」，游戏已经可以游玩，现阶段的工作重点是「改进和打磨」。更耐人寻味的是，Druckmann称《星际：异端先知》融合了顽皮狗另外三个知名系列的元素，每个系列都有所贡献。

paragraphs.en: "We used to have another game franchise called Jak and Daxter," Druckmann began. "And with this one, we really wanted to take everything we learned from that franchise, which is sci-fi fantasy, the action-adventure stuff we learned with Uncharted, the more kind of serious drama we got for The Last of Us, and it really is a combination of those three franchises.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们以前还有一个名为《Jak and Daxter》的游戏系列，」Druckmann首先说道，「而对于这款游戏，我们真的想吸取从那个系列中学到的一切，也就是科幻奇幻元素，以及我们从《神秘海域》中学到的动作冒险内容，还有我们在《最后生还者》中获得的那种更严肃的戏剧性。它确实是这三个系列的结合。

paragraphs.en: "We wanted to expand our deep gameplay systems," he added. "Can we sustain the cinematic storytelling we're used to doing and go even deeper with gameplay systems?"
paragraphs.cn: 「我们想扩展我们深度的游戏玩法系统，」他补充道，「我们能否在保持我们惯于采用的电影化叙事的同时，让游戏玩法系统更进一步？」

paragraphs.en: From the little that's been revealed of Intergalactic so far, we know that it will be an alternate universe sci-fi tale starring a bounty hunter stranded on a distant planet in the far future. This bounty hunter is Jordan A. Mun, played by Tati Gabrielle, with her bounty targets played by a roster of famous faces including Tony Dalton, Kumail Nanjiani and Ashley Scott. Naughty Dog regular Troy Baker is also set to appear.
paragraphs.cn: 从迄今为止公布的《星际：异端先知》的少量信息中，我们知道这将是一个发生在架空宇宙中的科幻故事，主角是一名在遥远未来被困在一颗遥远星球上的赏金猎人。这名赏金猎人叫Jordan A. Mun，由塔蒂·加布里埃饰演；她的悬赏目标则由一众知名演员饰演，包括托尼·达尔顿、库梅尔·南贾尼和阿什利·斯科特。顽皮狗的常客特罗伊·贝克也将出演。

paragraphs.en: Back in 2025, Intergalactic was reported to still be a couple of years from release , though PlayStation and Naughty Dog have refrained from narrowing its release window officially. That said, Druckmann recently indicated that the game would get a full unveiling at some point in the next 12 months .
paragraphs.cn: 早在2025年，就有报道称《星际：异端先知》距离发售还有几年时间，不过PlayStation和顽皮狗一直没有正式缩小其发售时间范围。话虽如此，Druckmann最近表示，这款游戏将在未来12个月内的某个时候全面亮相。

paragraphs.en: If it feels like a while since you've played something new from Naughty Dog, arguably PlayStation's most high-profile studio, you're not wrong. Naughty Dog's last all-new release was The Last of Us Part 2, which released back in 2020. The intervening years have seen the studio launch various remasters, and scrap a multiplayer The Last of Us spinoff after years of work.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你觉得自己已经有一段时间没玩到顽皮狗的新作了，那你并没有记错；顽皮狗可以说是PlayStation旗下最受瞩目的工作室。顽皮狗上一款全新作品是早在2020年发售的《最后生还者 第二部》。此后的几年里，工作室推出了多款重制版，并在开发多年后取消了一款《最后生还者》多人游戏衍生作品。

paragraphs.en: Intergalactic is just one of several projects in development at Naughty Dog, however, and fans now widely believe a new installment of Uncharted is also in the works .
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《星际：异端先知》只是顽皮狗正在开发的几个项目之一，粉丝们现在普遍认为《神秘海域》系列的一部新作也在开发中。
